title: Treasury yields move higher as investors mull uncertainty around peace talks
summary_full: The yield on the 10-year U.S. Treasury note — the key benchmark for U.S. government borrowing — rose 2 basis points to 4.708%.
summary_public: The yield on the 10-year U.S. Treasury note — the key benchmark for U.S. government borrowing — rose 2 basis points to 4.708%.
